```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(maps)
library(rnaturalearth)
library(here)

#load the extraction spreadsheet
est_data <- read_excel(here("Data/cholera_climate_systematic_review_extract_into_sheets.xlsx"), sheet = "estimates_0329")

est_data$eff_tl_year<- 1000
est_data$eff_tr_year<- 1000

for (idx in 1:nrow(est_data)) {
  if(!str_detect(est_data$eff_tl[idx],"-")){
    est_data$eff_tl_year[idx] <- year(as.Date(as.numeric(as.character(est_data$eff_tl[idx])),origin = "1899-12-30"))
    est_data$eff_tr_year[idx] <- year(as.Date(as.numeric(as.character(est_data$eff_tr[idx])),origin = "1899-12-30"))
  }else{
    est_data$eff_tl_year[idx] <- substr(est_data$eff_tl[idx],1,4)
    est_data$eff_tr_year[idx] <- substr(est_data$eff_tr[idx],1,4)
  }
}

est_data <- est_data %>% 
  mutate(
    eff_tl_year = as.numeric(eff_tl_year),
    eff_tr_year = as.numeric(eff_tr_year)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    `Study Period` = ifelse(
      eff_tr_year < 2000,"<2000",
      ifelse(
        eff_tl_year > 2010, ">2010", "2000-2010"
      )
    )
  )

meta_data <- read_excel(here("Data/cholera_climate_systematic_review_extract_into_sheets.xlsx"), sheet = "metadata_0329") %>% 
  filter(remove_keep == "keep")
```

```{r Table 1. Summary tables for the extraction, echo=FALSE,message=F}
# calculate number of unique country
country_list_period1 <- paste0(est_data[est_data$`Study Period`=="<2000",]$eff_country[!est_data$eff_country %in% c("multicountry in endemic countries in Africa","multicountry in non-endemic countries in Africa")],collapse = '|')
unique_country_list_period1 <- unique(str_split(country_list_period1,pattern = "\\|")[[1]])

country_list_period2 <- paste0(est_data[est_data$`Study Period`=="2000-2010",]$eff_country[!est_data$eff_country %in% c("multicountry in endemic countries in Africa","multicountry in non-endemic countries in Africa")],collapse = '|')
unique_country_list_period2 <- unique(str_split(country_list_period2,pattern = "\\|")[[1]])

country_list_period3 <- paste0(est_data[est_data$`Study Period`==">2010",]$eff_country[!est_data$eff_country %in% c("multicountry in endemic countries in Africa","multicountry in non-endemic countries in Africa")],collapse = '|')
unique_country_list_period3 <- unique(str_split(country_list_period3,pattern = "\\|")[[1]])

# Table 1. Number of papers, number of estimates and number of countries covered
est_data %>% 
  mutate(
    `Study Period` = factor(`Study Period`,levels = c("<2000","2000-2010",">2010"))
  ) %>% 
  group_by(`Study Period`) %>% 
  summarize(
    `Number of papers` = length(unique(studykey)),
    `Number of estimates` = n()
  )  %>% 
  mutate(
    `Number of countries` = c(length(unique_country_list_period1),length(unique_country_list_period2),length(unique_country_list_period3))
  )  %>% 
  kableExtra::kbl(caption = "Table 1. Summary for the extraction") %>% 
  kableExtra::kable_styling(full_width = FALSE) 


```

```{r Maps,fig.height=5,fig.width=15,echo=F,message=F}
#load world map
ne_sf <- ne_countries(returnclass = "sf")

# Number of papers by country overall
paper_country <- distinct(est_data[,colnames(est_data)%in%c("studykey","eff_country")])

new_paper_country <- data.frame()
for(idx in 1:nrow(paper_country)){
  if(str_detect(paper_country$eff_country[idx],"\\|")){
    tmp <- data.frame(eff_country = str_split(paper_country$eff_country[idx],"\\|")[[1]],
                      studykey = unique(paper_country$studykey[idx]))
    new_paper_country <- bind_rows(new_paper_country,tmp)
  } else{
    new_paper_country <- bind_rows(new_paper_country,paper_country[idx,])
  }
}

paper_country_tbl <- new_paper_country %>% 
  group_by(eff_country) %>% 
  summarize(
    `Number of papers` = n()
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    !eff_country %in% c("multicountry in endemic countries in Africa","multicountry in non-endemic countries in Africa")
  )

paper_country_tbl <- paper_country_tbl %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    adm0_shp =sf::st_as_sf(geodata::gadm(eff_country,level=0,path=tempdir()))$geometry[1]
  ) %>% 
  st_as_sf()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = paper_country_tbl,aes(fill = `Number of papers`)) +
  geom_sf(data=ne_sf, fill=NA,alpha=0)+  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("Figure 1. Number of papers by country")

# Number of papers by study period
paper_country_period <- distinct(est_data[,colnames(est_data)%in%c("studykey","Study Period","eff_country")])

new_paper_country_period <- data.frame()
for(idx in 1:nrow(paper_country_period)){
  if(str_detect(paper_country_period$eff_country[idx],"\\|")){
    tmp <- data.frame(eff_country = str_split(paper_country_period$eff_country[idx],"\\|")[[1]],
                      studykey = unique(paper_country_period$studykey[idx]),
                      `Study Period` = paper_country_period$`Study Period`[idx])
    new_paper_country_period <- bind_rows(new_paper_country_period,tmp)
  } else{
    new_paper_country_period <- bind_rows(new_paper_country_period,paper_country_period[idx,])
  }
}

paper_country_period_tbl <- new_paper_country_period %>% 
  group_by(eff_country,Study.Period) %>% 
  summarize(
    `Number of papers` = n()
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    !eff_country %in% c("multicountry in endemic countries in Africa","multicountry in non-endemic countries in Africa")
  )

paper_country_period_tbl <- paper_country_period_tbl %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    adm0_shp =sf::st_as_sf(geodata::gadm(eff_country,level=0,path=tempdir()))$geometry[1],
    Study.Period = factor(Study.Period, levels = c("<2000","2000-2010",">2010"))
  ) %>% 
  st_as_sf()

  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = paper_country_period_tbl,aes(fill = `Number of papers`)) +
  geom_sf(data=ne_sf, fill=NA,alpha=0)+
  facet_grid(cols=vars(Study.Period))+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("Figure 2. Number of papers by study period")

# Number of papers by exposure variables and period
paper_country_exp_period <- distinct(est_data[,colnames(est_data)%in%c("studykey","exp_class","eff_country","Study Period")])

new_paper_country_exp_period <- data.frame()
for(idx in 1:nrow(paper_country_exp_period)){
  if(str_detect(paper_country_exp_period$eff_country[idx],"\\|")){
    tmp <- data.frame(eff_country = str_split(paper_country_exp_period$eff_country[idx],"\\|")[[1]],
                      studykey = unique(paper_country_exp_period$studykey[idx]),
                      exp_class = paper_country_exp_period$exp_class[idx],
                      `Study Period` = paper_country_exp_period$`Study Period`[idx])
    new_paper_country_exp_period <- bind_rows(new_paper_country_exp_period,tmp)
  } else{
    new_paper_country_exp_period <- bind_rows(new_paper_country_exp_period,paper_country_exp_period[idx,])
  }
}

paper_country_exp_period_tbl <- new_paper_country_exp_period %>% 
  group_by(eff_country,exp_class,Study.Period) %>% 
  summarize(
    `Number of papers` = n()
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    !eff_country %in% c("multicountry in endemic countries in Africa","multicountry in non-endemic countries in Africa")
  )

paper_country_exp_period_tbl <- paper_country_exp_period_tbl %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(
    adm0_shp =sf::st_as_sf(geodata::gadm(eff_country,level=0,path=tempdir()))$geometry[1],
    Study.Period = factor(Study.Period, levels = c("<2000","2000-2010",">2010"))
  ) %>% 
  st_as_sf()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data=paper_country_exp_period_tbl,aes(fill = `Number of papers`)) +
  geom_sf(data=ne_sf, fill=NA,alpha=0)+
  facet_grid(rows=vars(exp_class),cols=vars(Study.Period))+
  theme_bw()+
  ggtitle("Figure 3. Number of papers by exposure variable and study period")
```

```{r Histograms,fig.height=5,fig.width=15,echo=F,message=F}
# whether exposure variables are spatially and temporally representative
#exposure
exp_data <- est_data[,colnames(est_data) %in% c("studykey","eff_country","exp_class","exp_temp_scale","exp_spatial_scale","exp_source")] %>% 
  mutate(
    exp_temp_tf = ifelse(exp_temp_scale == 99,0,1),
    exp_spatial_tf = ifelse(exp_spatial_scale == "not stated",0,1),
    exp_source_tf = ifelse(exp_source == "not stated",0,1)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    exp_score = exp_temp_tf + exp_spatial_tf + exp_source_tf
  ) %>% 
  group_by(
    studykey
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_exp_score = mean(exp_score)
  )

ggplot(data = exp_data, aes(x = avg_exp_score, fill = studykey)) +
  geom_histogram() +
  xlab("Average exposure-related scores across exposure category")+
  ggtitle("Figure 4. Distribution of average exposure-related scores across exposure category by study")

## exp_temp_scale: false=99
## exp_spatial_scale: false=not stated
## exp_source: false= not stated

#outcome (bimodal distribution)
out_data <- est_data[,colnames(est_data) %in% c("studykey","eff_country","out_class_metric","out_class_case_presentation","out_medicattended","out_temp_scale","out_spatial_scale","case_def_raw")] %>% 
  mutate(
    out_class_case_presentation_tf = ifelse(out_class_case_presentation == "not stated",0,1),
    out_temp_tf = ifelse(out_temp_scale == 99,0,1),
    out_spatial_tf = ifelse(out_spatial_scale == "not stated",0,1),
    out_case_df_tf = ifelse(case_def_raw == "not stated",0,1)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    out_score = out_class_case_presentation_tf + out_spatial_tf + out_temp_tf + out_case_df_tf
  ) %>% 
  group_by(
    studykey
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_out_score = mean(out_score)
  )

ggplot(data = out_data, aes(x = avg_out_score, fill = studykey)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  xlab("Average outcome-related scores across exposure category")+
  ggtitle("Figure 5. Distribution of average outcome-related scores across exposure category by study")


#association effect
a_data <- est_data[,colnames(est_data) %in% c("studykey","eff_country","exp_out_spatial_scale_match","a_effect","a_adjusted","a_uncert_def")] %>% 
  mutate(
    a_match_tf = ifelse(exp_out_spatial_scale_match == "unknown",0,1),
    a_class_tf = ifelse(a_effect == "not stated",0,1),
    a_adjusted_tf = ifelse(a_adjusted == "not stated",0,1),
    a_uncert_def_tf = ifelse(a_uncert_def == "not stated",0,1)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    a_score = a_match_tf + a_class_tf + a_adjusted_tf + a_uncert_def_tf
  ) %>% 
  group_by(
    studykey
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_a_score = mean(a_score)
  )

ggplot(data = a_data, aes(x = avg_a_score, fill = studykey)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  xlab("Average association effect-related scores across exposure category")+
  ggtitle("Figure 6. Distribution of average association effect-related scores across exposure category by study")

# Total scores by combining exposure variables, outcome variables and association effects.
tot_data <- est_data[,colnames(est_data) %in% c("studykey","eff_country","exp_class","exp_temp_scale","exp_spatial_scale","exp_source","out_class_metric","out_class_case_presentation","out_medicattended","out_temp_scale","out_spatial_scale","case_def_raw","exp_out_spatial_scale_match","a_effect","a_adjusted","a_uncert_def")] %>% 
  mutate(
    exp_temp_tf = ifelse(exp_temp_scale == 99,0,1),
    exp_spatial_tf = ifelse(exp_spatial_scale == "not stated",0,1),
    exp_source_tf = ifelse(exp_source == "not stated",0,1),
    out_class_case_presentation_tf = ifelse(out_class_case_presentation == "not stated",0,1),
    out_temp_tf = ifelse(out_temp_scale == 99,0,1),
    out_spatial_tf = ifelse(out_spatial_scale == "not stated",0,1),
    out_case_df_tf = ifelse(case_def_raw == "not stated",0,1),
    a_match_tf = ifelse(exp_out_spatial_scale_match == "unknown",0,1),
    a_class_tf = ifelse(a_effect == "not stated",0,1),
    a_adjusted_tf = ifelse(a_adjusted == "not stated",0,1),
    a_uncert_def_tf = ifelse(a_uncert_def == "not stated",0,1)
    
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    tot_score = exp_temp_tf + exp_spatial_tf + exp_source_tf + out_class_case_presentation_tf + out_spatial_tf + out_temp_tf + out_case_df_tf + a_match_tf + a_class_tf + a_adjusted_tf + a_uncert_def_tf
  ) 

tot_data_by_study <- tot_data %>% 
  group_by(
    studykey
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_tot_score = mean(tot_score)
  )

ggplot(data = tot_data_by_study, aes(x = avg_tot_score, fill = studykey)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  xlab("Average total scores across exposure category")+
  ggtitle("Figure 7. Distribution of average total scores across exposure category by study")

tot_data_by_study_exp <- tot_data %>% 
  group_by(
    studykey,exp_class
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_tot_score = mean(tot_score)
  )

ggplot(data = tot_data_by_study_exp, aes(x = avg_tot_score, fill = studykey)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(exp_class)) +
  xlab("Total scores by exposure category")+
  ggtitle("Figure 8. Distribution of total scores by exposure category and study")

# total scores by continent
new_tot_data <- data.frame()
for(idx in 1:nrow(tot_data)){
  if(str_detect(tot_data$eff_country[idx],"\\|")){
    tmp <- tot_data[idx,] %>% slice(rep(1, each = length(str_split(tot_data$eff_country[idx],"\\|")[[1]])))
    tmp$eff_country = str_split(tot_data$eff_country[idx],"\\|")[[1]]
    new_tot_data <- bind_rows(new_tot_data,tmp)
  } else{
    new_tot_data <- bind_rows(new_tot_data,tot_data[idx,])
  }
}

new_tot_data <- new_tot_data %>% filter(!eff_country %in% c("multicountry in endemic countries in Africa","multicountry in non-endemic countries in Africa")) %>% 
  mutate(
    continent = ifelse(
      eff_country %in% c("BGD","CHN","IND","IRN","MYS","PAK","VNM"),"Asia",
      ifelse(
        eff_country %in% c("YEM","HTI","PER"), "Other","Africa"
      )
    )
  )

tot_data_by_study_continent <- new_tot_data %>% 
  group_by(
    studykey,continent
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_tot_score = mean(tot_score)
  )

ggplot(data = tot_data_by_study_continent, aes(x = avg_tot_score, fill = studykey)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(continent)) +
  xlab("Total scores by continent")+
  ggtitle("Figure 9. Distribution of total scores by continent and study")


tot_data_by_study_continent_exp <- new_tot_data %>% 
  group_by(
    studykey,continent,exp_class
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_tot_score = mean(tot_score)
  )

ggplot(data = tot_data_by_study_continent_exp, aes(x = avg_tot_score, fill = studykey)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(continent),cols = vars(exp_class)) +
  xlab("Total scores by continent and exposure category")+
  ggtitle("Figure 10. Distribution of total scores by continent, category and study")

tot_prop_data_by_study_continent_exp <- new_tot_data %>% 
  group_by(
    studykey,continent,exp_class
  ) %>% 
  summarize(
    avg_tot_score_prop = mean(tot_score)*100/11
  )

ggplot(data = tot_prop_data_by_study_continent_exp, aes(x = avg_tot_score_prop, fill = studykey)) +
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_grid(rows = vars(continent),cols = vars(exp_class)) +
  xlab("Proportion of scores by continent and exposure category")+
  ggtitle("Figure 11. Distribution of total scores by continent, exposure category, and study")
```

```{r Extracted estiamtes histograms,fig.height=5,fig.width=15,echo=F,message=F}
new_est_data <- data.frame()
```
